nodes.label: Mireward Reach / Golden Fields
nodes.description: The northern Reach and Golden Fields travel region between Mirathorn and Mireward.

nodes.label: Mirathorn
nodes.description: City the party cannot reliably contact; later reported to be in another corruption outbreak.

nodes.label: Mireward
nodes.description: Northern destination and walled town reached at the session cliffhanger.

nodes.label: The swamp / cult source
nodes.description: The believed origin of the corruption problem and the party mission target.

nodes.label: Lysandra
nodes.description: Lieutenant and party ally trying to keep the team focused on reaching the swamp and destroying the cult source.

nodes.label: Lysandro
nodes.description: Lysandra's father, revealed at the Mireward wall.

nodes.label: Private Hester
nodes.description: Young Elderwild Reach rider carrying sealed reports for Mirathorn and warning about swamp music.

nodes.label: Commander Vale
nodes.description: Commander Hester tells Lysandra to speak with before entering the swamp.

nodes.label: Grobnok
nodes.description: Mirathorn contact who takes over the rockie-talkie and becomes the sole evening caller.

nodes.label: Professor Tealeaf
nodes.description: Trusted Wizard's College contact the party tries to message; later works with Grobnok to regain control.

nodes.label: Frank
nodes.description: Former rockie-talkie holder Grobnok says appears compromised.

nodes.label: Sara
nodes.description: Mirathorn operator Grobnok has not seen recently.

nodes.label: Mirathorn council
nodes.description: City authority that hires mercenaries and instructs the party to continue to the swamp.

nodes.label: Mirathorn city guard
nodes.description: Decimated guard further reduced by corruption during the renewed outbreak.

nodes.label: Mirathorn hired mercenaries
nodes.description: Mercenaries hired by the council because the city guard is reduced.

nodes.label: Meat heads
nodes.description: Corrupted faction in Mirathorn recruiting openly for the Shepherd.

nodes.label: The Shepherd
nodes.description: Cult figure for whom the meat heads recruit.

nodes.label: Dustwalker
nodes.description: Festival performer whose song the party recognizes in the shared humming.

nodes.label: Thrin
nodes.description: Party member who asks Ephanna whether the forest can lie and is spared by the gnats.

nodes.label: Delayed puddle reflections
nodes.description: Magical puddles whose reflections lag behind reality.

nodes.label: Conjuration planar bleed
nodes.description: Puddle magic that appears to be bleed from another plane, conjured by an unknown source.

nodes.label: Northern rhythm / shared song
nodes.description: A rhythm from the north that becomes a shared humming recognized as the Dustwalker festival song.

nodes.label: Abandoned meat-on-a-stick restaurant
nodes.description: Recently abandoned roadside restaurant where the party shelters from hail; the sign reads headed south, north wrong.

nodes.label: Converging hail storm
nodes.description: Major storm/hail wall that forces the party to shelter.

nodes.label: Unseen knocking door
nodes.description: Karsemine hears knocking where she cannot find any door.

beats.title: Party sends silver raven to Mirathorn
beats.summary: After failed rockie-talkie contact, the group sends Tealeaf and Grobnok a spoken/written message by silver raven.

evidence_refs.label: Party sends silver raven to Mirathorn

beats.summary: Hester carries reports for Mirathorn and reports mysterious music, swamp-walkers, glassy eyes, and Commander Vale.

evidence_refs.label: Private Hester warns of swamp music

beats.title: Delayed puddles reveal conjuration bleed
beats.summary: Karsemine notices delayed reflections; Caelynn detects conjuration and the party worries about planar bleed.

beats.title: Grobnok reports renewed Mirathorn outbreak
beats.summary: Grobnok says Frank appears compromised, Sara is unseen, corruption returned, mercenaries were hired, and the council orders the party onward.

beats.summary: Karsemine hears rhythm from the north, Ephanna sees savory mist at dawn, and no Grobnok call comes.
